Class TerrainManager

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.terrain.TerrainManager
public final class TerrainManager extends Object
Terrain facade used by Main.java and other modules to coordinate procedural materials, chunk streaming, wind-driven vegetation, and world reseeding.

      public TerrainManager(com.jme3.scene.Node rootNode, com.jme3.asset.AssetManager assets, com.jme3.renderer.Camera camera, GameConfig config, WindModel wind)
      Creates the terrain manager with its scene, asset, camera, configuration, and wind services.
      Parameters:
      rootNode - scene node receiving terrain
      assets - engine asset manager
      camera - camera used for chunk and grass streaming
      config - validated runtime settings
      wind - shared deterministic wind model
